name: ActBlue
summary: The main online fundraising platform for Democratic candidates and causes, which has processed nearly $17 billion in donations since 2004. In April 2025 Trump signed a memorandum directing the Justice Department to investigate online platforms, ActBlue by name, over alleged straw and foreign donations; ActBlue said it would challenge the order in court.
